$schema_note: Accepted Supabase database-linter findings. Anything emitted by `supabase db lint` that is NOT listed here will fail the CI security gate. Format: each entry is { name, level, reason } where `name` is the linter rule slug (e.g. 0029_authenticated_security_definer_function_executable). See @security-memory for the full rationale.

accepted.name: 0029_authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: public.current_user_has_role(app_role) intentionally exposes EXECUTE to authenticated so a signed-in client can check its own auth.uid() role for UI gating. Authoritative protection lives in RLS on the underlying tables.

accepted.name: 0029_authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: public.has_role(uuid, app_role) is SECURITY DEFINER and called from RLS policies on user_roles and other admin-gated tables. RLS is evaluated under the calling role, so authenticated must retain EXECUTE for policies to resolve. Anon + PUBLIC have been revoked. The function only reads from public.user_roles and cannot escalate privileges.

accepted.name: 0029_authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: Internal helpers exposed to authenticated by design: admin_list_live_classes, get_audit_retention_days, get_live_class_meeting_url, live_class_rsvp_count, preview_purge_access_audit_logs, purge_access_audit_logs, set_audit_retention_days, student_cancel_booking, publish_recording_public, unpublish_recording_public, enqueue_email, read_email_batch, delete_email, move_to_dlq. Each enforces its own auth.uid() / has_role / ownership checks server-side; SECURITY DEFINER is required so they can write audit rows and access admin-gated tables.

accepted.name: 0028_anon_security_definer_function_executable
accepted.reason: Public token-lookup helpers exposed to anon by design: get_class_by_share_token and get_recording_by_token. They only return rows matched by an unguessable share/public token and never expose meeting URLs or storage paths beyond the published recording surface.

accepted.name: 0010_security_definer_view
accepted.reason: public.live_classes_public is intentionally an owner-defined view (security_invoker=false) that projects a safe column subset of public.live_classes — it omits meeting_url and share_token. The base table's RLS is now owner/admin-only; the view is the sole public read path for class metadata.

accepted.name: 0010_security_definer_view
accepted.reason: public.site_profile_data_public is intentionally an owner-defined view (security_invoker=false) restricted to slug='bdjobs'. It is the only public read path for the published profile page; the base table site_profile_data is admin-only.
